The '''Pervi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Pervian blood crow]]s.<ref name="LukeSkywalkerShadowsMindor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pervi system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
